stem: Which of these is a lesson Roddy learns in the story?

options.label: A
options.text: Teamwork is important when trying to accomplish a goal.

options.label: B
options.text: Relying on good friends is helpful in difficult situations.

options.label: C
options.text: Drawing conclusions without enough information can lead to mistakes.

options.label: D
options.text: People should not judge others by their appearance.
